mergedParams.userDescription: Animated stroke or outlines. internal effects for text, video, images

prompts.prompt: Create an internal effect preset that generates animated stroke outlines using CSS border animations. The effect should create a drawing/tracing effect where the border appears to be drawn around text, images, or video elements progressively. Use AnimationRange[] to animate border-width from 0 to a customizable thickness, combined with opacity transitions. The stroke should start from one corner and wrap around the element clockwise. Support parameters for stroke color, thickness, duration, and whether to keep the stroke visible at the end or fade it out. The effect should use GPU-accelerated properties where possible.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: Generic (AnimationRange[]). Properties to animate: border (width, color, opacity), optional box-shadow for glow effect. Structure: { type: 'generic', mode: 'provider', targetIds: string[], start: 0, duration: number, ranges: { border: [{key: 'borderWidth', val: '0px', prog: 0}, {key: 'borderWidth', val: params.strokeWidth, prog: 0.8}], opacity: [{key: 'borderOpacity', val: 0, prog: 0}, {key: 'borderOpacity', val: 1, prog: 0.3}] }}. Input params: { strokeWidth: z.string().default('3px'), strokeColor: z.string().default('#ffffff'), duration: z.number().default(1000), fadeOut: z.boolean().default(false), glowIntensity: z.number().optional() }. Return format: { effects: [effectData] }

prompts.prompt: Design an audio-reactive outline effect preset that pulses and glows in sync with bass frequencies. The effect should create dynamic outlines around any target element (text, video, image) that react to music beats by changing thickness and intensity. Use waveform effects to modulate both the outline thickness and a glow effect based on bass levels. The outline should use CSS box-shadow with multiple layers for the glow effect, scaling the shadow spread and blur radius based on audio intensity. Include threshold controls to filter out weak beats.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: Waveform (audio-reactive). Waveform config: { type: 'scale', audioProperty: 'bass', sensitivity: 1.5, threshold: 0.3 }. Combined with generic effect for base outline. Structure: [{ type: 'waveform', mode: 'provider', targetIds: string[], props: { scale: { min: 1, max: 1.15, audioProperty: 'bass' }, filter: { type: 'drop-shadow', intensity: { min: 0, max: 20 } } } }, { type: 'generic', ranges: { boxShadow: AnimationRange[] } }]. Input params: { baseColor: z.string(), glowColor: z.string(), sensitivity: z.number().min(0.5).max(3), threshold: z.number().min(0).max(1) }. PresetMetadata: { _internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects' }

prompts.prompt: Build a morphing outline effect that transforms between different stroke styles - from solid to dashed to dotted patterns. The effect should animate CSS outline-style and stroke-dasharray properties to create a morphing border effect. Include smooth transitions between different dash patterns, with customizable dash lengths and gaps. The effect should work on SVG elements for images/videos (using SVG filters) and CSS outlines for text. Support multiple morph stages with different patterns in sequence.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: Generic (AnimationRange[]). Properties: outline-style, stroke-dasharray, stroke-dashoffset for animation. Structure: { type: 'generic', mode: 'provider', targetIds: string[], ranges: { strokeDasharray: [{val: '0 0', prog: 0}, {val: '10 5', prog: 0.33}, {val: '2 8', prog: 0.66}, {val: '20 0', prog: 1}], strokeDashoffset: [{val: 0, prog: 0}, {val: -30, prog: 1}] }}. Input params: { patterns: z.array(z.object({ dash: z.number(), gap: z.number(), duration: z.number() })), strokeWidth: z.string(), color: z.string() }. Uses CSS custom properties for dynamic values.

prompts.prompt: Create a neon sign outline effect with flickering animations that simulates realistic neon tube lighting. The effect should use multiple box-shadow layers with different blur radii and colors to create the neon glow. Include random flicker patterns using AnimationRange with non-linear progression values to simulate electrical interference. The outline should have an inner bright core and outer color glow. Support different neon colors and flicker intensities, with options for steady glow or intermittent flickering.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: Generic with complex AnimationRange[]. Properties: box-shadow (multiple layers), opacity, filter (brightness). Structure: { type: 'generic', mode: 'provider', targetIds: string[], ranges: { boxShadow: [{val: generateNeonShadow(params.color, 0), prog: 0}, {val: generateNeonShadow(params.color, 1), prog: 0.1}, {val: generateNeonShadow(params.color, 0.3), prog: 0.15}], opacity: flickerPattern }}. Flicker pattern uses random prog values: [0, 0.12, 0.125, 0.2, 0.25]. Input params: { neonColor: z.string(), flickerIntensity: z.number().min(0).max(1), steadyGlow: z.boolean(), glowRadius: z.number() }. Helper function for multi-layer shadows.

prompts.prompt: Develop a magnetic outline effect that appears to be attracted to or repelled by cursor/touch positions. The effect creates dynamic outlines that shift and distort based on interaction zones. Use transform matrices and clip-path animations to create the magnetic distortion effect. The outline should stretch towards or away from defined attraction points, with elastic easing for natural motion. Include parameters for magnetic strength, attraction/repulsion mode, and elastic tension.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: Generic with transform matrices. Properties: transform (matrix), clip-path, border-radius. Structure: { type: 'generic', mode: 'provider', targetIds: string[], ranges: { transform: [{val: 'matrix(1,0,0,1,0,0)', prog: 0}, {val: calculateMagneticMatrix(params.strength), prog: 0.5}], clipPath: dynamicClipPath }}. Easing: 'spring' for elastic motion. Input params: { magnetStrength: z.number(), mode: z.enum(['attract', 'repel']), elasticity: z.number(), attractionPoints: z.array(z.object({ x: z.number(), y: z.number() })) }. Uses CSS transforms for GPU acceleration.

prompts.prompt: Create a glitch outline effect that simulates digital corruption and data errors. The effect should create multiple offset outlines with RGB channel separation, flickering between different positions and colors. Use CSS filters and transforms to create the glitch aesthetic with random displacement values. Include scanline effects using linear gradients in the outline. The glitch should have controlled chaos - random but within defined parameters for artistic control.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: Combined (multiple generic effects). Properties: transform (translateX/Y), filter (hue-rotate, contrast), outline-offset, color. Structure: [{ type: 'generic', ranges: { transform: glitchTransform, filter: [{val: 'hue-rotate(0deg)', prog: 0}, {val: 'hue-rotate(180deg)', prog: 0.1}] }}, { type: 'generic', ranges: { outlineOffset: randomOffsets }}]. Glitch positions use random prog values with sharp transitions. Input params: { glitchIntensity: z.number(), colorShift: z.boolean(), scanlines: z.boolean(), duration: z.number() }. Return format: { effects: [...multipleEffects] }

prompts.prompt: Design a breathing outline effect that expands and contracts rhythmically, simulating organic breathing or pulsing motion. The effect should use smooth sine wave interpolation for natural expansion/contraction of the outline width and opacity. Include options for asymmetric breathing (different inhale/exhale durations) and variable breath depths. The outline should also subtly change color saturation during the breath cycle, becoming more vivid at peak expansion.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: Generic with sine wave interpolation. Properties: outline-width, outline-offset, opacity, filter (saturate). Structure: { type: 'generic', mode: 'provider', targetIds: string[], duration: params.breathDuration, ranges: { outlineWidth: generateSineWave(params.minWidth, params.maxWidth, params.breathCount), opacity: generateSineWave(0.6, 1, params.breathCount), filter: [{val: 'saturate(0.8)', prog: 0}, {val: 'saturate(1.2)', prog: 0.5}] }}. Input params: { breathDuration: z.number(), breathCount: z.number(), minWidth: z.string(), maxWidth: z.string(), asymmetry: z.number() }. Uses custom sine wave generator for smooth animation.

prompts.prompt: Build a spectrum analyzer outline effect that visualizes frequency data as animated borders. The effect creates multiple concentric outlines that react to different frequency bands (bass, mid, treble), with each ring responding to its assigned frequency range. Use waveform effects combined with CSS custom properties to create dynamic multi-ring outlines. The rings should have different colors representing different frequencies, creating a visual equalizer effect around the element.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: Combined waveform effects. Structure: [{ type: 'waveform', mode: 'provider', targetIds: string[], props: { scale: { audioProperty: 'bass', min: 1, max: 1.2 } }}, { type: 'waveform', props: { scale: { audioProperty: 'mid', min: 1, max: 1.15 } }}, { type: 'waveform', props: { scale: { audioProperty: 'treble', min: 1, max: 1.1 } }}]. Each creates different outline layer via box-shadow. Input params: { bassColor: z.string(), midColor: z.string(), trebleColor: z.string(), sensitivity: z.number(), ringCount: z.number() }. PresetMetadata: { _internalPreset: true, _internalPresetOutput: 'effects', dependencies: { presets: [] } }

prompts.prompt: Create an electric arc outline effect that generates animated lightning-like borders around elements. The effect should use SVG filters for displacement mapping combined with animated stroke-dasharray to create crackling electrical arcs. Include random branching patterns that spawn sub-arcs from the main outline. The electricity should have realistic behavior with faster movement at arc endpoints and occasional bright flashes. Support color temperature settings from cool blue to hot white electricity.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: Generic with SVG filters. Properties: filter (custom SVG turbulence), stroke-dasharray, stroke-dashoffset, opacity. Structure: { type: 'generic', mode: 'provider', targetIds: string[], ranges: { filter: [{val: 'url(#electric-turbulence-0)', prog: 0}, {val: 'url(#electric-turbulence-1)', prog: 0.1}], strokeDasharray: electricPattern, opacity: flashPattern }}. SVG filter includes feTurbulence and feDisplacementMap. Input params: { voltage: z.number(), colorTemp: z.number().min(2000).max(10000), arcDensity: z.number(), flashFrequency: z.number() }. Includes SVG filter generation logic.

prompts.prompt: Develop a liquid outline effect that simulates viscous fluid borders with surface tension animations. The effect should create organic, blob-like outlines that flow and merge using CSS border-radius animations and clip-path morphing. Include parameters for viscosity (how quickly the liquid flows), surface tension (how much the outline wants to maintain its shape), and gravity direction. The liquid should appear to drip or flow based on the gravity setting, with realistic acceleration curves.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Effect type: Generic with complex morphing. Properties: border-radius (all corners independently), clip-path (polygon points), transform (for flow direction). Structure: { type: 'generic', mode: 'provider', targetIds: string[], easing: 'ease-in-out', ranges: { borderRadius: generateLiquidMorph(params.viscosity), clipPath: [{val: initialPolygon, prog: 0}, {val: flowPolygon, prog: 1}], transform: gravityTransform }}. Input params: { viscosity: z.number().min(0.1).max(1), surfaceTension: z.number(), gravity: z.object({ direction: z.number(), strength: z.number() }), droplets: z.boolean() }. Uses physics-based interpolation for realistic motion.
